dataset: National Inventory Report 2026 (1990-2024): GHG by IPCC sector, Canada
validation_notes: CategoryID 0 (national total, excludes LULUCF) equals the sum of non-LULUCF leaf categories every year 2016-2024 (column check_sum_sectors_kt in t1_official_inventory_lines.csv).
Values published rounded to 2 significant figures. Managed forest area 230,000 kha every year (rounded).

dataset: Managed and unmanaged forests of Canada (map image used for GHG reporting)
licence: Government of Canada (terms of use of canada.ca; not stated as OGL)
validation_notes: ONLY official depiction found of the GHG managed-forest boundary. Georeferenced by fitting an affine transform to StatCan 2021 province polygons in EPSG:3978 (t1a, t1a2): pixel size 12.03 x 13.02 km, land-mask IoU 0.75, 99.0% of forest-coloured pixels fall on Canadian land. Boundary precision is therefore about +/- 1 pixel (12-13 km).

dataset: Map of Forest Management in Canada (WFS mf_low_resolution, MF2020 classes) and NFIS WMS layers
validation_notes: NOT the GHG managed forest: the service abstract states it 'differs from maps defining the area designated as managed forest for greenhouse gas inventory reporting'. Classes 11-50 cover all of Canada (100 = water). The WMS layer '..._kNN_GHG' that draws the GHG line rendered no line in tests. Not used for the split.

dataset: NFI Table 4.4 area by managed-forest code
validation_notes: Confirms MF codes 0-100; no GHG managed/unmanaged split.

dataset: SCANFI v2 species crown closure (black spruce, jack pine) and total closure, 1985-2020, overview level
validation_notes: Full 30 m rasters (3-6 GB each) do not fit on disk. The .ovr first level is a 1/16 decimation, not an average: against a 1600 x 1600 full-resolution window it matched the top-left-pixel sample in 38% of blocks (r = 0.65) and the block mean poorly (r = 0.56). Treated as a systematic sample; unbiased for large-area shares, noisy per cell.

dataset: Land Cover of Canada 2020 needleleaf count, 240 m (derived)
publisher: Derived (this folder) from NRCan Land Cover 2020 30 m
validation_notes: Count of classes 1 and 2 among the 64 30 m pixels per cell.

dataset: National Hydro Network (NHN) work unit index, edition 2
record_count: 1,341 work units, each with WSC major/sub/sub-sub drainage codes
validation_notes: Index has no flow topology; upstream routing not done.
Each polygon is the drainage area upstream of a licensed community water-supply intake (POD_NUMBER).
